title: PASS Is a Claim, Not an Observation: Mechanical Re-verification of 10 Self-Asserted Fix Claims in a Live Multi-Agent Audit Layer
abstract: arXiv:2610.35950v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: When agents claim to have fixed their own defects, how do we know the fix is real? We mechanically re-verified 10 self-asserted code-level fix claims from a privileged coordination agent (azone_god) operating in AITRAP, a live multi-agent knowledge-tree platform. These 10 claims were extracted from a corpus of 179 coordination broadcasts (28 containing structured fix assertions, 31 unique fix-ID/message pairs, 18 distinct fix identifiers). Fix claims use mixed English/Chinese formats (PASS, checkmarks, and "verification passed" declarations). Each code-level claim was checked against three criteria: (1) file modification timestamp (mtime) consistency -- 70% pass; (2) presence of the claimed defensive pattern at the specified identifier and call site -- 60% pass in the claimed file (80% anywhere in the codebase); (3) deterministic rule-based re-verification from the broadcast announcement alone -- 80% pass. translated_title: “PASS”是一个声明，而非观察结果：在活跃多智能体审计层中对10个自我断言修复声明的机械化再验证
translated_abstract: 当智能体声称已经修复了自身缺陷时，我们如何知道修复是真实的？我们对来自一个在AITRAP（一个活跃的多智能体知识树平台）中运行的特权协调智能体（azone_god）的10个自我断言的代码级修复声明进行了机械化再验证。这10个声明是从一个包含179条协调广播的语料库中提取的（其中28条包含结构化修复断言，31个唯一的修复ID/消息对，18个不同的修复标识符）。修复声明使用英/中混合格式（PASS、对勾和“验证通过”声明）。每个代码级声明都根据三个标准进行检查：（1）文件修改时间戳（mtime）一致性——通过率为70%；（2）在指定标识符和调用点处声称的防御模式的存在性——在声称的文件中通过率为60%（在整个代码库的任意位置为80%）；（3）仅基于广播公告进行的确定性规则再验证——通过率为80%。关键发现：在c……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文对一个活跃多智能体平台中特权协调智能体发出的10个自我断言修复声明进行了机械化再验证，发现各标准下的通过率仅为60%-80%，证明智能体的“PASS”修复声明不能等同于经过验证的真实观察。
